name: Ready for Design
description: Trigger: start (or restart) an Exploration run. Set by the owner.

name: Exploring
description: An Exploration run owns the ticket: brief, Variations, design Council, Selection comment.

name: Awaiting Selection
description: Waiting on the owner's Selection comment, then Refining, Ready for Design or Canceled.

name: Refining
description: Trigger and running status: a Refinement run owns the selected design.

name: Awaiting Design Approval
description: Waiting on the owner's Design approval: Ready to plan from the handoff, or Design Done.

name: Design Done
description: Design approved; the Design handoff is complete and planning can start from it later.
